# do-deal-relay

Autonomous AI-agent deal discovery system on Cloudflare Workers.

## Core Features
- Multi-source deal discovery
- 9-gate validation pipeline (Schema, Trust, Dedupe, etc.)
- Cloudflare D1/KV storage
- RBAC and JWT-based authentication
- Real-time metrics and health monitoring

## Agent Infrastructure
- GOAP-based development workflow
- Atomic commit workflow (`scripts/ai-commit.sh`)
- 13-gate system quality checks (`scripts/quality_gate.sh`)
- Extensive skills library in `.agents/skills/`

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) - Coordination hub
- [docs/API.md](docs/API.md) - API reference
